'''Arts and culture'''
*The [[Miss Universe]] and [[Miss Indonesia]] contests cut ties after six Miss Indonesia contestants allege [[sexual misconduct]] at the [[beauty pageant]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/aug/13/miss-universe-cuts-ties-with-indonesia-pageant-over-sexual-assault-claims (''The Guardian'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 Hawaii wildfires]]
**In the [[United States]], [[Maui County, Hawaii|Maui County]] officials announce that more than 93 people have died in the [[wildfire|wildfires]] in [[Lahaina, Hawaii|Lahaina]], [[Maui]], [[Hawaii]], making it the deadliest [[Wildfires in the United States|American wildfire]] since 1918, surpassing the death toll of the 2018 [[Camp Fire (2018)|Camp Fire]] in [[California]]. [https://www.washingtonexaminer.com/news/hawaii-fire-death-toll-93-deadliest-wildfire-100-years (''Washington Examiner'')] [https://people.com/hawaii-fire-death-toll-reaches-93-becomes-deadliest-us-wildfire-in-more-than-100-years-7642859 (People.com)]
**[[Governor of Hawaii|Hawaii Governor]] [[Josh Green (politician)|Josh Green]] says that the [[Banyan tree in Lahaina|banyan tree]] in Lahaina was damaged by the wildfires, but has survived. [https://themessenger.com/news/mauis-beloved-generations-old-banyan-tree-survives-devastating-hawaii-wildfires-but-not-unscathed (''The Messenger'')]
**Two restaurants in Lahaina, the Mala Ocean Tavern and Duckine, are reported to have survived the wildfires. The two restaurants confirmed this in a joint statement on [[Instagram]], but also stated that they won't be able to open "any time soon". [https://www.sfchronicle.com/food/restaurants/article/maui-restaurants-survive-wildfire-18294101.php (''San Francisco Chronicle'')]
*Four people are killed and four others are injured in separate accidents involving [[lightning strike]]s in the [[Governorates of Yemen|Yemeni governorates]] of [[Al Bayda Governorate|Al Bayda]], [[Al Hudaydah Governorate|Al Hudaydah]], and [[Raymah Governorate|Raymah]]. [https://english.news.cn/20230813/f3b7db51c3784c8bb10a3c3dadd5a738/c.html (Xinhua)]
*Three people are killed and eighteen others are injured in a fire at an [[apartment|apartment complex]] in [[Grasse]], [[Alpes-Maritimes]], [[France]]. [https://nos.nl/artikel/2486456-doden-en-gewonden-door-brand-in-wooncomplex-zuid-franse-stad-grasse (NOS)]
